translations.source_sense_description: Physik: einen elektrischen Widerstand aufweisend (in Komponente oder Material)

glosses: Tending to resist something or someone; resistant.

examples.text: He had a stubborn, resistive nature.

glosses: Acting as a resistor; resisting the passage of electrical current.
Of an electronic circuit: consisting only of resistors and power sources; having no inductance and capacitance.

translations.source_sense_description: Physik: einen elektrischen Widerstand aufweisend (in Komponente oder Material)

glosses: Se dit de ce qui a trait à la capacité de résistance.

examples.text: Un élément résistif. Un circuit résistif.
